title: wsw-2004-world-title
label: “Electric” Evan Sky

won.source: Named on the same broadcast as a former WSW Champion, who pinned Alternativ for it and defended it three more times before retiring undefeated.

note: The promotion's own broadcast frames this as the champion's in-storyline retirement, undefeated.

title: wsw-2004-world-title
label: “Superstar” Sean Southward

won.source: Already WSW Champion when Western States Wrestling's 2002 run opens at Retribution, May 26, 2002.

note: Defended without loss against Krusader, his brother Steve, Rick Carey (twice) and Paul Doom (twice) across the promotion's 2002 run.

Won by submission (the Luv Struck) over Mr. Ed on Western States Wrestling's July 3 Wednesday Night broadcast.

title: wsw-2004-interstate-title
label: Mr. Chumleywarner

won.source: Won by submission (an ankle lock) over Rukus The Luv Train at Summer Showdown.

note: Western States Wrestling's own July 24 and later broadcasts rebill Rukus The Luv Train as champion without airing his win back; no such document survives.

title: wsw-2004-pacific-northwest-title
label: Dean King

won.source: Retribution's own broadcast: Dean King beat Diablo in the last WSW European Championship match to found the Pacific Northwest Championship.

how: Rolled through a reversed Diablo splash.

title: wsw-2004-pacific-northwest-title
label: Jason Reynolds

won.source: Won over Dean King on Western States Wrestling's July 3 Wednesday Night broadcast.

note: Defended against Karnage, Steve Southward, Derek Craven (twice) and Dean King across the promotion's 2002 run.

title: wsw-2004-light-heavyweight-title
label: Knuckles

won.source: Retribution's own broadcast: Knuckles beat the champion, Rukus The Luv Train, already holding the title when Western States Wrestling's 2002 run opens.

note: Retained against Mr. Chang on June 5 and fought Kendo Nakamura to a draw at Summer Showdown.

title: wsw-2004-television-title
label: Kid Dynamic

won.source: Won over the champion, Nemesis, already holding the title when Western States Wrestling's 2002 run opens, on its June 5 Wednesday Night broadcast.

how: Cobra clutch Russian legsweep, the Truly Dynamic.

title: wsw-2004-television-title
label: Kano

won.source: Won over “Kid Dynamic” on Western States Wrestling's July 3 Wednesday Night broadcast.

note: Defended against Mr. Ed at Summer Showdown and Kendo Nakamura on July 24.

title: wsw-2004-tag-team-title
label: The New Midnight Express

won.source: Retribution's own broadcast: the New Midnight Express beat the New Generation for the vacant title, left open by Ionik's own in-storyline departure.

note: Retained against the New Age Outsiders at Summer Showdown; the Destruction Constructors earned a Tag Team title match for September 15's Lord of the Ring by the promotion's last surviving 2002 broadcast.

title: wsw-2004-north-american-title
label: Krim'nal

won.source: Retribution's own broadcast: Krim'nal won the promotion's last North American Championship match.

note: The promotion's own 2004 return still names him its last North American Champion; the title was never defended again in its 2002 run.

title: wsw-2004-hardcore-title
label: Nova Johnson

won.source: Retribution's own broadcast: Nova Johnson reached the duffel bag holding both existing Hardcore title belts first in a five-way cage battle royal, becoming the last WSW Hardcore Champion.

note: Handed the belt to Kano backstage on June 23 as a personal gesture, not a sanctioned title defense; the title was not contested again in the promotion's 2002 run.
